newsitem.title: POLAND: POLISH FIAT UNIT RISES CAR PRICES.
newsitem.headline: POLISH FIAT UNIT RISES CAR PRICES.

text.p: The Polish unit of Italy's Fiat Spa, the leader on Poland's car market, will increase the prices of five models it produces by 2.5 percent on the average as of January 2, PAP news agency said on Monday.
PAP quoted Fiat statement as saying that the increase, necessary to offset inflation, will affect Cinquecento, Uno, Punto, Bravo and Brava models.
After the rise Cinquecento will cost between 18,450 and 24,900 zlotys, depending on an engine and additional equipment.

Uno will cost between 24,900 and 27,200 zlotys, Punto between 29,300 and 32,100 zlotys, Bravo between 36,100 and 39,100 zlotys and Brava will cost 40,100 zlotys. The price of the popular Fiat 126 minicar will not change.
Fiat led the Polish automotive market with 145,700 units sold in the January-November period and a 42-percent share.
